description: Generate 1–1000 unique IDs with a cryptographic RNG: UUID v4 (random), UUID v7 (time-ordered, RFC 9562, strictly increasing within a batch), ULID (26 Crockford Base32 chars, monotonic) or NanoID (custom length 2–128 and alphabet: URL-safe default, alphanumeric, hex, digits, no look-alikes, or your own). Options: uppercase, no dashes. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/uuid-forge/

alphabet.description: NanoID alphabet: a preset ("A-Za-z0-9_-", "A-Za-z0-9", "0-9a-f", "0-9", "nolook") or your own characters (2–256 distinct; duplicates ignored).

length.description: NanoID length (2–128). 21 URL-safe chars ≈ UUID v4 collision safety.

noDashes.description: UUIDs only: drop the dashes (32 hex chars).

uppercase.description: Upper-case output (UUID hex digits, ULID letters). Default false = lower case, like the website.

name: id_generate
title: Generate IDs (UUID / ULID / NanoID)
